Read Rosie’s Module 4 introduction

Hi, it’s Rosie. You’ve explored careers, checked the real-world evidence, and looked at what you already bring. Now it’s time to decide what makes the most sense next. In Decide, BOOST will bring forward your evidence and show one of four pathway signals: Ready, Bridge, Build, or Reconsider. Ready means the evidence supports employment first. Bridge means a manageable gap may be closed while working through something like OJT, apprenticeship, or employer-supported development. Build means a larger documented gap may require targeted training, education, or a credential. Reconsider means more evidence—or another option—deserves attention before you invest. The pathway signal is not the decision. You’ll review it, choose the direction that makes sense to you, and save a summary to discuss with your Career Coach. Let’s turn what you’ve learned into a plan.

BUILD • Training & Funding Check

Before you invest, make the training path visible.

This check appears only when your selected direction is BUILD. It helps you and your Career Coach confirm that a training option exists and estimate how the cost might be covered before anyone commits to a program.

1 • Confirm the training option.
Search Arizona Job Connection to see whether an appropriate program is listed on Arizona’s Eligible Training Provider List (ETPL). An ETPL listing does not guarantee funding, but it is an important planning check.
